steps.what: Conduct actual interviews, consultations, role playing and participant observation
Assess observation quality and relevant intervention evidence
Design the intervention procedure and its limits
Write and check the actual intervention procedure

loop.purpose: Restate the sociologist's chosen procedure and boundaries
loop.input: intervention design decisions and checked evidence
loop.check: Sociologist checks sequence, meaning, evidence, limitations and omitted conditions before saving
loop.stop: Unsupported intervention claim or two failed drafts returns writing to the sociologist
loop.why_not_simpler: Native procedure headings first; group-specific rationale needs bounded prose restatement

tasks.design: Use native procedure headings in {DOCS}, with a bounded restatement of the sociologist's own intervention design. Keep all actual interviews, observation, evidence appraisal and procedure selection human, including complete meaning checks of the written procedure.
tasks.previous_blocker: Writing the chosen procedure repeats decisions already made from actual observations.
tasks.still_hard: Interpreting group interactions and anticipating unintended intervention effects.
tasks.human_edge: Understand context, trust and what the observations fail to establish.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less procedure wording, without new intervention authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: supported procedure restatement can assist writing, while interviews, observation and intervention design remain human.

assumptions: Provisional shares include actual procedure development and its written procedure, not a new activity record. Implementation or participant communication is outside this development task and must be separately counted if assigned.

s1 captures actual observations and contextual notes with its time retained. s2 verifies sources and limitations. s3 supplies sequence, intended effects, exclusions and unresolved questions before s4; no model infers participant motives.
Test native headings first. Two removed points concern supported restatement only. Complete meaning review, missing-fact repair and ordinary ungated author save remain within s4.
Use only an approved research-data route; no uncounted transcript or synthetic participant evidence is assumed.
research_questions: Does supported restatement reduce writing after the sociologist's complete procedural meaning check?

incremental.description: Maintain procedure structure and source-bound drafting checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 10 times 20%=2 restatement points less 0.6 upkeep gives 1.4. An unfamiliar group context needs bespoke rationale and limitations, leaving only 0.8 point of factual restatement removable and 0.2 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise administrators, social workers or legislators on research implications

steps.what: Verify the relevant research findings and the client's policy question
Consult with the client and explain social issues and research implications
Write the client's requested research-implications brief

loop.purpose: Restate the sociologist's advice without inventing policy implications
loop.input: actual advice findings and checked evidence
loop.check: Sociologist checks causal language, relevance, limits, uncertainty and omissions against the actual advice
loop.stop: Unsupported implication or two failed drafts returns writing to the sociologist
loop.why_not_simpler: Native brief headings first; contextual research implications need limited prose restatement

steps.what: Check the final brief, evidence and exact client recipient
Send the exact authorised brief to the policy client

tasks.design: Use a native {DOCS} brief structure and bounded restatement only where the client actually requested written research implications. Keep source verification, consultation, policy judgement and complete final checking human, then retain a separate gated {EMAIL} send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Requested advice briefs restate research implications already discussed with the client.
tasks.still_hard: Separating research evidence from value choices and unsupported policy causation.
tasks.human_edge: Explain uncertainty and the limits of transferring findings to the client's situation.
tasks.altitude: Less requested brief wording; advisory responsibility unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-bound restatement can assist an actual client brief without determining policy advice.

assumptions: Provisional shares describe a consultation with an actual requested client brief, not a mandatory internal advice record. Oral-only consultations remove and reweight s3-s5, with no brief-writing benefit assumed.

The client produces the policy question; s1 verifies findings and source references. s2 captures the actual advice and limitations, with capture counted. Missing context requires human follow-up, not inferred policy positions.

Native brief headings are tested first. Three removed points are supported restatement only. All reading, conversation, original implication judgements, complete checks and ordinary author saves remain.
s4 binds the exact final brief and external client recipient after it exists; changes void send approval. No extra trailing activity record is created.
unknowns: Whether written advice is actually requested
research_questions: Is the written brief an existing client deliverable, and does restatement reduce its actual writing time?

incremental.description: Maintain advice-brief structure and drafting checks

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact final brief, source attachments and client recipient; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20 times 15%=3 restatement points less 0.7 upkeep gives 2.3. For a disputed social policy requiring bespoke caveats, only 1 point of supported factual restatement disappears, giving 0.3 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Direct staff compiling and evaluating research data

steps.what: Review the study protocol, current datasets and staff's actual work
Prepare actual data-compilation and evaluation assignments for the research staff
Direct statistical clerks and statisticians and resolve actual research-work questions

tasks.design: Use native study/dataset reference defaults in {PROJECT} for actual staff assignments. Keep protocol reading, assignment substance and live direction human; no employee ranking, automated allocation or trailing supervision log is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Study, dataset and codebook references are repeatedly entered while assigning actual work.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising methodological mistakes and matching instructions to the work's actual difficulty.
tasks.human_edge: Explain research decisions and resolve ambiguous data problems with staff.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated assignment reference entry; supervisory rights unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native project-linked fields can reuse assignment references without deciding research methods or directing people.

assumptions: Provisional shares describe real written research assignments followed by live direction; no new post-meeting record is created. Staff's own compilation/evaluation labour is outside the focal denominator and remains unchanged.

The study process supplies study, dataset version and codebook identifiers. s1 verifies them; s2 determines the actual instructions and manually resolves missing references. s3 is live communication, not an uncounted electronic send.

Test native defaults first. The 2.1 removed points in s2 are repeated study/dataset/codebook reference entry; the remaining 12.9 retain all assignment decisions, instructions and ordinary ungated save.
Do not add a separate supervision diary or pretend that defaults reduce staff mentoring.
unknowns: Whether assignments already inherit study references
research_questions: Do current assignments require repeated references, or are they already linked to the study?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15 times 14%=2.1 repeated-reference points less 0.5 upkeep gives 1.6. A new dataset and codebook need manual reference setup, leaving only 0.8 point of stable study identifier reuse and 0.3 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collaborate with researchers in other disciplines

steps.what: Read collaborators' actual findings and methods
Collaborate on research questions, methods and interpretation across disciplines
Write and verify the agreed sociological methods contribution

loop.purpose: Restate the sociologist's actual agreed methods contribution
loop.input: joint research decisions and checked method context
loop.check: Sociologist checks method meaning, agreements, discipline differences and omitted limitations before saving
loop.stop: Unclear agreement or two failed drafts returns writing to the sociologist
loop.why_not_simpler: Native methods structure first; interdisciplinary terminology needs limited contextual restatement

tasks.design: Use a native methods structure in {DOCS} and bounded restatement for an actual agreed written methods contribution. Keep disciplinary reading, collaboration, methodological choices and complete meaning verification human; no extra collaboration diary is added.
tasks.previous_blocker: A shared methods contribution can require restating agreed decisions across disciplinary terminology.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-bound restatement with the contributing sociologist's full check.
tasks.still_hard: Different assumptions and incompatible meanings across disciplines.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise apparent agreement that conceals a real methodological difference.
tasks.altitude: Less limited methods restatement, with research responsibility unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: restatement can support an actual shared methods document while interdisciplinary agreement remains human work.

assumptions: Provisional shares describe collaboration with an actual assigned methods contribution, read by the research team; no mandatory meeting note is invented. Conversation-only collaboration removes and reweights s3.

Collaborators produce their findings and methods; s1 includes reading and source clarification. s2 captures actual agreed research decisions, with capture time retained. Unresolved differences remain explicit rather than being rewritten as agreement.
Test native methods headings first. Only 2.6 points of supported wording disappear; all methodological choices, meaning verification, source repair and ordinary ungated author save remain.
The contribution is edited in the shared working document. No separate send or formal publication is assumed; add actual final-version action steps where those are assigned.
unknowns: Actual written contribution in this collaboration
research_questions: Is the methods contribution a real existing deliverable, and can restatement preserve all unresolved differences?

incremental.description: Maintain methods structure and cross-discipline wording checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20 times 13%=2.6 restatement points less 0.6 upkeep gives 2. A new disciplinary partnership requires bespoke terminology and rationale; only 0.8 point of supported factual wording disappears, giving 0.2 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain intervention design, advice and research collaboration while reducing only actual supported writing or repeated assignment references.
skills_to_grow: Preserve methodological disagreement in shared documents
role.ambitious_version: Use verified recovered writing time for source interpretation and direct collaboration.
